questions.question: Do any country-year points count as outliers relative to the whole-series mean within the specified time frame, and what does the zoomed shape indicate about the 2015 dip?

answer.value: Against the entire timeline, nothing crosses the two-sigma rule—so the anomaly layer stays empty even after zooming. Within 2014–2016 you can still read the mid-decade sag and rebound in electricity access as a regional story inside the band, not as a machine-flagged spike.

key_insights: The global mean/std anomaly test does not flag any points in this dataset.
The 2014–2016 window is still useful for eyeballing the dip-and-recovery pattern without relying on red markers.

reasoning.reasoning: Narrows the time axis to the shock-and-recovery years.
Checks for extreme residuals versus the overall series distribution.
